svg.title: Where the jobs run and which hosts they reach
svg.desc: The jobs event, apply, sweep, sync-labels and findings run on ubuntu-24.04 behind Harden-Runner in block mode, without sudo and containers, and reach api.github.com and github.com. The job analyze runs on ubuntu-24.04-firewall and reaches the hosts of .github/egress-firewall.yaml. Every other host is blocked for both.
